## Dependencies

```{julia}
#| include: false
using CategoricalArrays, DataFrames, JLD2, Mice, OrderedCollections, Plots

datalist = OrderedDict(
	"imputed_data_premh" => ["Main dataset", "Mental health → On-screen people exposure statistics"],
	"imputed_data_postmh" => ["Main dataset", "On-screen people exposure statistics → Mental health"],
	"R_imputed_data_premh" => ["Main dataset (imputed in R)", "Mental health → On-screen people exposure statistics"],
	"R_imputed_data_postmh" => ["Main dataset (imputed in R)", "On-screen people exposure statistics → Mental health"],
	"imputed_data_sens_auxil_premh" => ["Sensitivity analysis dataset without potential colliders as auxiliary variables", "Mental health → On-screen people exposure statistics"],
	"imputed_data_sens_auxil_postmh" => ["Sensitivity analysis dataset without potential colliders as auxiliary variables", "On-screen people exposure statistics → Mental health"],
	"imputed_data_sens_wd_premh" => ["Weekday-only sensitivity analysis dataset", "Mental health → On-screen people exposure statistics"],
	"imputed_data_sens_wd_postmh" => ["Weekday-only sensitivity analysis dataset", "On-screen people exposure statistics → Mental health"],
	"imputed_data_sens_we_premh" => ["Weekend-only sensitivity analysis dataset", "Mental health → On-screen people exposure statistics"],
	"imputed_data_sens_we_postmh" => ["Weekend-only sensitivity analysis dataset", "On-screen people exposure statistics → Mental health"],
	"imputed_data_sens_missingness_premh" => ["Sensitivity analysis dataset without participants with >75% of periods of phone use classed as missing", "Mental health → On-screen people exposure statistics"],
	"imputed_data_sens_missingness_postmh" => ["Sensitivity analysis dataset without participants with >75% of periods of phone use classed as missing", "On-screen people exposure statistics → Mental health"],
	"imputed_data_sens_conf_premh" => ["Sensitivity analysis dataset with person exposure summary statistics not requiring minimum 70% confidence in people detections", "Mental health → On-screen people exposure statistics"],
	"imputed_data_sens_conf_postmh" => ["Sensitivity analysis dataset with person exposure summary statistics not requiring minimum 70% confidence in people detections", "On-screen people exposure statistics → Mental health"]
);

datasets = OrderedDict();
for i in eachindex(datalist)
	push!(datasets, i => load("resources/" * i * ".jld2", i))
end;
```

## Diagnostic plots
The diagnostic plots from each set of imputations are displayed below. Use the sliders to view the different variables across the imputed datasets.

```{julia}
#| echo: false
gr()
ENV["GKSwstype"] = "100";
```

```{julia}
#| output: asis
for y in unique([x[1] for x in values(datalist)])
	println("### ", y, "\n")

	for z in unique([x[2] for x in values(datalist)])
		k = collect(keys(datalist))[findfirst(x -> x[1] == y && x[2] == z, collect(values(datalist)))]
		v = datasets[k]

    	println("#### ", z, "\n")
	
    	# Generate all plots and save as images
    	img_paths = String[]
    	for i in eachindex(v.visitsequence)
    	    p = plot(v, i)
    	    imgpath = "multiple_imputation_files/plots/$(k)_$(i).svg"
    	    savefig(p, imgpath)
    	    push!(img_paths, imgpath)
    	end
	
    	# Create JavaScript array string
    	js_array = "[" * join(["'$path'" for path in img_paths], ", ") * "]"
	
    	# Create HTML slider
    	html_code = """
    	<div>
    	    <input type="range" min="1" max="$(length(img_paths))" value="1" 
    	           id="slider_$(k)" oninput="updatePlot_$(k)(this.value)">
    	    <span id="label_$(k)">Variable: 1</span>
    	    <br>
    	    <img id="plot_$(k)" src="$(img_paths[1])" width="100%">
    	</div>
    	<script>
    	function updatePlot_$(k)(val) {
    	    const images = $(js_array);
    	    document.getElementById('plot_$(k)').src = images[val-1];
    	    document.getElementById('label_$(k)').innerText = 'Variable: ' + val;
    	}
    	</script>
    	"""
	
    	println("```{=html}")
    	println(html_code)
    	println("```\n")
	end
end
```
